annotation.title_clean: Council Decision (EU) 2025/2350 on the position to be taken on behalf of the European Union within the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe on the Draft Recommendation on equality and artificial intelligence
annotation.title_en: Council Decision (EU) 2025/2350 on the position to be taken on behalf of the European Union within the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe on the Draft Recommendation on equality and artificial intelligence
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Council Decision setting the EU position on the Council of Europe's draft Recommendation on equality and AI. Member States, acting jointly, are not to object to its approval, provided the text does not conflict with or exceed obligations under the EU AI Act.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU position is to not object to approval and adoption of the Recommendation
Condition: no changes inconsistent with or exceeding AI Act obligations on providers and deployers
Position expressed by Member States acting jointly
Recommendation is non-binding but can produce legal effects in EU law via the AI Act
Decision enters into force on adoption
